contexts.text: This state resembles the morning twilight. (Explained.)
The mountains of twilight (). ( = the evils of falsity; for... it is twilight when truth is not seen; but falsity instead. AE 405:52.)

To stumble in the noonday as in the twilight () = to go astray in falsities, although able to be in light from the Word. ( = a falling into errors, although they are in the Church where the Word is, by which they might come into the light of truth. AE 781:18.)

Woe... to them who tarry into the twilight till wine inflame them () = the perverted states of those who believe that they are enlightened of themselves... To tarry into the twilight = to be enlightened.
